title: L2Batch Plugin Configuration
description: Configuration for Neo L2 Batch plugin - controls batch formation and sealing behavior

ChainId.description: Unique identifier for this L2 chain within the Neo Elastic Network

MaxBlocksPerBatch.description: Maximum number of L2 blocks to include in a single batch before auto-sealing

MaxTransactionsPerBatch.description: Maximum number of transactions to accumulate in a batch before sealing

MaxBatchAgeMillis.description: Maximum time (milliseconds) to wait for more txs/blocks before forcing batch seal

Enabled.description: Whether batch plugin is active and producing batches
